title: Window: sokol_app.h integration (window creation, frame loop)
acceptance_criteria: C wrapper file defines sokol_app.h callbacks callable from assembly
sapp_init() configures window title, width (1024), height (768)
sapp_frame_cb() called each frame from assembly main loop
sapp_event_cb() receives and forwards keyboard/mouse events
Assembly main() calls sapp_run() with callback struct
Window opens on Linux X11 and displays blank frame without crashing
Frame rate is stable at 60 FPS (verified via frame counter)
